triggerDescription: Task reassignment initiated by project manager or director

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Resource assignment updated on activity; critical path recalculated with new resource calendar and availability constraints
Employee project allocation percentages adjusted; previous assignee freed and new assignee committed for the task duration
Field task assignment updated; daily log responsibility transferred; safety induction status verified for new assignee

notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A task on your project has been reassigned. The schedule has been recalculated and the updated critical path is available for review.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A resource reassignment has been processed. Workforce utilization metrics have been updated across affected projects.

triggerDescription: Request for Information approved by project team lead or director

propagationChain.dataUpdate: RFI status set to approved; linked drawings and specifications flagged for revision; distribution list notified automatically
BIM model elements linked to the RFI flagged for design coordination review; clash detection re-queued if geometry is affected
Schedule impact assessment triggered; affected activities evaluated for duration or logic changes based on RFI resolution

notificationMessages.persona-sophie: An RFI on your project has been approved. Review the updated documentation and check for any schedule impacts.
notificationMessages.persona-elena: An approved RFI may affect cost estimates. Review linked scope items for potential cost implications.

triggerDescription: Budget allocation modified by finance controller or project director

propagationChain.dataUpdate: General ledger updated with revised budget allocation; cost center budgets adjusted; variance reports recalculated against new baseline
Procurement commitment limits adjusted to reflect new budget ceiling; purchase requisition approval thresholds recalibrated
Earned value baseline updated with revised budget at completion (BAC); CPI and EAC metrics recalculated

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A budget allocation has been updated. Portfolio financial summary and variance reports have been refreshed.
notificationMessages.persona-elena: Budget allocation has changed on a project. Review the updated cost plan and procurement commitment limits.

triggerDescription: Project risk escalated to senior management for executive review

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Risk severity upgraded to critical; risk added to portfolio-level risk register; executive review workflow initiated
Schedule risk analysis re-run with updated risk parameters; Monte Carlo simulation refreshed with new probability distributions
Contingency reserve flagged for potential drawdown; financial exposure report updated with escalated risk value

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A risk has been escalated to executive level. Review the updated portfolio risk register and approve the mitigation strategy.
notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A risk on your project has been escalated. The schedule risk analysis has been refreshed with updated parameters.

triggerDescription: Contract variation order approved including scope, cost, and schedule changes

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Contract sum updated; revised budget committed in financial system; cash flow forecast adjusted for additional scope value
New procurement requirements generated for additional scope items; purchase requisitions created for materials and subcontract packages
Schedule updated with additional activities and revised completion milestone; resource requirements recalculated
Variation order logged in document control system; distributed to site team and subcontractors via automated notification

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A variation order has been approved. The contract sum and project budget have been updated. Review the revised financial baseline.
notificationMessages.persona-elena: A variation order has been approved affecting the project budget. New procurement requirements have been generated for your review.
notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A variation order has been approved on your project. The schedule has been updated with additional activities and a revised completion date.

triggerDescription: Interim payment application certified after quantity surveyor review

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Payment instruction generated and queued for accounts payable processing; payment due date calculated per contractual terms
Goods receipt confirmed against certified quantities; inventory records updated for materials received on site
Payment certification record linked to project documentation; contractor notified of certified amount and expected payment date

notificationMessages.persona-elena: An interim payment has been certified. The payment instruction has been generated and queued for processing.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A payment certification has been processed. Cash flow forecast has been updated with the committed payment.

triggerDescription: Non-conformance report issued against subcontractor or work package

propagationChain.dataUpdate: NCR logged in quality management system; corrective action deadline set per contractual requirements; responsible party formally notified
Supplier performance score updated to reflect non-conformance; NCR count incremented in vendor quality history
Cost of rectification tracked against project contingency; potential back-charge initiated against subcontractor retention

notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A non-conformance report has been issued on your project. Review the corrective action plan and monitor the response deadline.
notificationMessages.persona-elena: An NCR has been issued which may result in rectification costs or back-charges. Review the financial impact assessment.

triggerDescription: Bid proposal formally submitted to client through tender process

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Opportunity stage updated to 'Proposal Submitted'; submission timestamp recorded; bid team notified of successful submission
Revenue forecast updated with weighted pipeline value adjustment based on submission probability uplift
Resource pre-allocation flagged for mobilization planning; key personnel availability reserved pending bid outcome

notificationMessages.persona-james: Your proposal has been successfully submitted. The pipeline has been updated and the opportunity stage advanced.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A new proposal has been submitted. Revenue forecast and resource pre-allocation have been updated accordingly.

triggerDescription: Client interaction logged and relationship health score updated

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Client health score recalculated based on new engagement data; engagement timeline updated; automated follow-up reminders scheduled
Stakeholder communication log updated if engagement is linked to an active project; action items synced to project tracker

notificationMessages.persona-james: Client engagement record has been updated. The health score has been recalculated and follow-up reminders have been set.

triggerDescription: Team members moved between projects to resolve resource conflicts

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Employee assignment records updated with new project allocation percentages; timesheet templates adjusted for affected personnel
Resource histograms recalculated for all affected projects; schedule re-leveled based on new resource availability
Site access permissions updated for reassigned personnel; safety induction requirements verified for new project assignments

notificationMessages.persona-sophie: Resources have been reallocated across your projects. Review the updated team assignments and schedule impacts.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A resource reallocation has been processed. Workforce utilization metrics and project schedules have been updated.

triggerDescription: Procurement package awarded to recommended supplier following tender evaluation

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Purchase order generated and transmitted to awarded supplier; unsuccessful tenderers notified with debriefing offer
Budget commitment recorded against the project cost code; accounts payable schedule updated with expected payment milestones
Supplier compliance checks verified and contract record created; insurance and certification validity confirmed
Delivery milestones added to project schedule based on supplier lead times and contractual delivery dates

notificationMessages.persona-elena: A procurement award has been approved. The purchase order has been generated and budget commitment recorded.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A procurement package has been awarded. Project budget commitments and delivery milestones have been updated.

triggerDescription: Regulatory compliance report submitted to authority or governance body

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Compliance submission logged with authority reference number; acknowledgement receipt recorded with timestamp
Project compliance tracker updated with submission date, reference number, and expected response timeline
ESG metrics updated if report includes environmental or sustainability data; compliance score recalculated

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A compliance report has been submitted to the regulatory authority. The portfolio compliance dashboard has been updated.
notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A compliance report for your project has been submitted. The project compliance tracker reflects the submission status.

triggerDescription: Project schedule re-baselined following approved change or recovery plan

propagationChain.dataUpdate: New baseline stored; all SPI and CPI metrics recalculated from new reference; previous baseline archived for audit trail
Updated milestone dates distributed to field teams and subcontractors; look-ahead schedules regenerated
Cash flow forecast updated to align with revised schedule milestones; payment projection dates recalculated

notificationMessages.persona-sophie: The schedule baseline has been updated. All earned value metrics have been recalculated and new milestone dates distributed.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A project schedule has been re-baselined. Portfolio performance metrics and cash flow forecasts have been refreshed.

triggerDescription: Key milestone or decision point recorded in strategic partnership

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Partnership timeline updated with milestone record; stakeholder notifications triggered; next milestone reminders configured
Joint venture financial tracking updated if milestone has revenue implications; partnership revenue recognition adjusted

notificationMessages.persona-james: A partnership milestone has been logged. The partnership timeline and stakeholder notifications have been updated.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A strategic partnership milestone has been recorded. Review the updated partnership status and any financial implications.

triggerDescription: Subcontractor claim formally rejected with documented justification

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Claim status updated to rejected; amount removed from accrued liabilities; financial exposure reduced in project forecast
Claim rejection letter generated with contractual references; logged in contract administration records; subcontractor formally notified
Subcontractor claims history updated; dispute flag set if subcontractor indicates intent to escalate

notificationMessages.persona-elena: A subcontractor claim has been rejected. The financial forecast has been updated and the rejection has been formally documented.
notificationMessages.persona-sophie: A subcontractor claim on your project has been rejected. Monitor for potential dispute escalation from the subcontractor.

triggerDescription: Consolidated executive performance report compiled from all connected systems

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Project performance data extracted including progress metrics, quality KPIs, and safety statistics consolidated into report template
Financial KPIs, budget utilization, cost variance, and cash flow data pulled for the reporting period
Schedule performance metrics, milestone status, SPI/CPI values, and critical path summary extracted
Workforce utilization rates, capacity data, open positions, and resource allocation summary included in report

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: Your executive report has been generated. Data has been consolidated from all connected systems and is available in the executive dashboard.

triggerDescription: Environmental, social, and governance metrics updated for a project

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Sustainability dashboard updated with new metrics; project sustainability score recalculated; trend analysis refreshed
Project environmental compliance status refreshed; site environmental monitoring records updated
Regulatory reporting data flagged for update if environmental thresholds are affected; next submission deadline highlighted

notificationMessages.persona-lukas: ESG metrics have been updated. The portfolio sustainability dashboard and compliance status have been refreshed.
notificationMessages.persona-sophie: ESG metrics for your project have been updated. Review the environmental compliance status for any threshold changes.

triggerDescription: Revenue forecast model generated from pipeline data and contract backlog

propagationChain.dataUpdate: Forecast snapshot saved with weighted pipeline values, probability adjustments, and sector breakdowns; version history maintained
Revenue projection data shared with financial planning module for budget alignment and quarterly target reconciliation

notificationMessages.persona-james: A new revenue forecast has been created. The forecast snapshot is available for review and has been shared with the finance team.
notificationMessages.persona-lukas: A revenue forecast has been generated. Financial planning data has been updated for budget alignment review.
